crac.tuto.etape1: [Tutorial] 1. Find a flat spot you like. The bases world is PvP: only your green outline protects you, for %s at most.
crac.tuto.etape2: [Tutorial] 2. Building plan in hand, right click: place %s foundations side by side.
crac.tuto.etape3: [Tutorial] 3. Then 5 walls, 1 “Doorway” piece (door included) and 2 floors on top for the roof.
crac.tuto.etape4: [Tutorial] 4. Place the Claim Block on a foundation, inside: the base is yours, and protected from raids.
crac.tuto.etape5: [Tutorial] 5. Hammer in hand: upgrade your pieces to wood, and put planks in the Claim Block (upkeep).
crac.tuto.etape6: [Tutorial] Once your base is placed, your home is created there: from the spawn, /home takes you back (every 3 min). From your base, /spawn takes you to the spawn; from the spawn, /zone base takes you to a random spot of the building zone.
